title: Power Main Relay and Power Window Motor

content.description: Power main relay diagram showing continuity test between terminals 1 and 3, with no continuity between terminals 2 and 4

items.heading: INSPECT RELAY CONTINUITY
items.text: Inspect that there is continuity between terminals 1 and 3. Inspect that there is no continuity between terminals 2 and 4.

content.description: Power main relay diagram showing continuity test between terminals 2 and 4 with battery voltage applied between terminals 1 and 3

items.heading: INSPECT RELAY OPERATION
items.text:
Inspect the continuity between terminals 2 and 4 with battery voltage applied between terminals 1 and 3.

If continuity is not as specified, replace the relay.

content.description: Sequential diagram showing power window operation test with switch at UP position and circuit breaker operation within 4 to 40 seconds

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: With the window in the full closed position, hold the power window switch at "UP" and check that there is a circuit breaker operation noise within 4 to 40 seconds.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: With the window in the fully closed position, hold the switch at "DOWN" and check that the window begins to descend within 60 seconds.

content.description: Power window motor terminal diagram showing terminal positions 1 and 2

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1 and connect the negative (−) lead to the terminal 2, and check that the motor turns clockwise.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 2 and connect the negative (−) lead to the terminal 1, and check that the motor turns counter-clockwise.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the motor.
